diffs.diff: PM1.0 concentration (ug/m3): datasheet reading gives 1 per count, the part's model has none
diffs.evidence: Plantower PMSA003 datasheet, Appendix I output frame: "Data1 refers to PM1.0 concentration unit ug/m3 (CF=1, standard particle)" and "Data4 refers to PM1.0 concentration unit ug/m3 (under atmospheric environment)" - the 16-bit word is the concentration in ug/m3 directly. The part's model already uses exactly 1 ug/m3 per count: sim.uartStream and sim.uartReplies send pm1/value(PM2.5)/pm10 as 16-bit words with "scale": 1 in both the CF=1 (words 1-3) and atmospheric (words 4-6) slots, and the driver returns the raw words w[0..5] unscaled as ug/m3. The gate reports 'none' only because it reads conversions from sim.measure/measures/responses, not from uartStream/uartReplies; datasheet Resolution row: "Resolution 1 ug/m3".
